note: Set A captures sheet-note and material facts that B omits entirely — the solar-thermal-array spacing note, the tilt/turn door operation, cement fibre board siding, the 2x4 cedar handrail and powdercoated steel flatbar railing post assemblies, and the 40-tube count — with correct window/door tag pairings. Set B instead repeats itself heavily (cable-rail diameter three times, finished floor and solar envelope values three to four times each) and adds a miscomputed claim that 18'-0" is the finished-floor-to-solar-envelope height when 18'-0" is the envelope elevation above grade (grade-to-FF is 2'-9 1/2"). Both sets share one misbound claim ("Steel Column" powdercoated steel with a quote that does not appear; the text reads POWDERCOATED STEEL FLATBAR RAILING POST TYP.), while A adds two further unsupported claims ("FLAT BLACK" finish and a fabricated "1/8\" STEEL SINGLE HOUGHY" quote for a column thickness). A's broader correct coverage of notes and assemblies outweighs its extra errors versus B's redundancy and misread height, though B does correctly capture the finished floor elevation and drawing scale that A misses.
